cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xxiii, 11) य॑भति (or Ā. ˚ते, Vet.; pf. ययाभ Gr.; aor. अयाप्सीत्, ib.; fut. यप्स्य॑ति, TBr.; inf. यभितुम्, BhP., यब्धुम्, TBr., Sch.),
to have sexual intercourse, futuere, AV. &c. &c.:
Desid. यियप्सति, ˚ते, to desire sexual intercourse, ŚrS.
to be carnally known (see अ॑- and सु॑यभ्या).
याभ—वत् mfn. having sexual intercourse, Kāvyād.
(instr. pl. f. of 3. य) whereby, that, in order that, RV. viii, 1, 8.
